Topics covered in this PDF

BEGE-105 (Understanding Prose) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Critical appreciation of three prose passages, "The Legacy", The Binding Vine, Lamb's "A Dissertation Upon Roast Pig"
  • Boswell's Life of Johnson, The Diary of a Young Girl, Nehru's "The Quest of Man", "Misery"

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.
